title: The Sanguine Monolith
subtitle: The Crimson Lodestone
text: The Monolith counsels from the fifth Degree, when the Vicar steps back as an equal. The Vicar's scrap is its blueprint, and its Quintessence is a creature's lifeblood crystallized by the Rite of Exsanguination. At the seventh Degree its builder may press it until it shatters. It breaks into a Qliphoth Seed and eight Monolith Fragments. At Degree 5 it is raised as a Working craft. Build its frame beside the Cardinal Focus of a Greater Working floor or larger, seat a Sanguine Formation in the Focus and light Sanguine Quintessence and an Echo Shard in the braziers. Feed the frame 175 mL and the floor takes it.
